exact_locators.supported_observation: The article explicitly identifies seven Munda-language varieties in its typology: Ho, Kera Mundari, Kharia, Mundari, Remo (Bondo), Santali and Sora (Savara).
The authors state that field-collected data are paired with legacy lexicographic sources, while Mundari is represented through dialectal fieldwork on Kera Mundari.

exact_locators.locator: publisher full text, Section 2 Reduplication in Munda
exact_locators.supported_observation: The paper presents a typological overview of reduplication before focusing on mimetic reduplication across syntactic class, semantic domain and phonological form.
